name: Fritz
source:
Fritz is the caretaker and tutor to Prince Werne. He cares deeply about the prince, but is a weak individual that often lets the prince boss him around with his high and mighty attitude, and often Fritz finds that he can't keep the prince out of trouble no matter how hard he tries.

[From: [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/silver/silver.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
